claim: Remote-sensing and climate covariates are reproducible only when collection ID, date range, aggregation, cloud-quality rule, missing-data handling and exported asset version are recorded.
conditions: NDVI is a date-window composite from Sentinel-2 surface reflectance and CHIRPS is aggregated over a specified interval.
limitations: A composite can hide seasonal variation and may not align with the soil sampling date.
recommended_action: Save the Earth Engine collection IDs, start/end dates, cs or cs_cdf threshold, reducer, projection, scale and export date in the project QA manifest.
not_allowed_action: Do not label a covariate simply NDVI or rainfall without temporal and processing provenance.
